mn102:22.7: adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ nirāmisassa sukhassa nirodhā uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn102:22.8: tayidaṃ saṅkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ atthi kho pana saṅkhārānaṃ nirodho atthetanti
mn102:22.9: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī tathāgato tadupātivatto.
mn102:23.1: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā aparantānudiṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā sabbaso kāmasaññojanānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānā pavivekāya pītiyā samatikkamā nirāmisassa sukhassa samatikkamā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya samatikkamā
mn102:24.2: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā aparantānu diṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā sabbaso kāmasaññojanānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānā pavivekāya pītiyā samatikkamā nirāmisassa sukhassa samatikkamā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya samatikkamā
mn102:24.5: atha panāyaṃ bhavaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhiṃ vā upādiyamāno upādiyati aparantānudiṭṭhiṃ vā upādiyamāno upādiyati kāmasaññojanaṃ vā upādiyamāno upādiyati pavivekaṃ vā pītiṃ upādiyamāno upādiyati nirāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ upādiyamāno upādiyati adukkhamasukhaṃ vā vedanaṃ upādiyamāno upādiyati.
mn102:24.7: santohamasmi nibbutohamasmi anupādānohamasmīti samanupassati tadapi imassa bhoto samaṇabrāhmaṇassa upādānamakkhāyati.
mn102:24.8: tayidaṃ saṅkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ atthi kho pana saṅkhārānaṃ nirodho atthetanti
mn102:24.9: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī tathāgato tadupātivatto.
mn102:25.1: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave tathāgatena anuttaraṃ santaṃ varaṃ padaṃ abhisambuddhaṃ yadidaṃ channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimokkho tayidaṃ bhikkhave tathāgatena anuttaraṃ santaṃ varaṃ padaṃ abhisambuddhaṃ yadidaṃ
mn102:25.2: channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimokkhoti.
mn102:25.4: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
